notes.title: Changes That Are On The Way!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Work is in Progress[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40405820/7f4e2a3ffe8054f1992f9cc7dee2997d920cc63f.jpg[/img]
[i]image of the current work in progress tutorial level[/i]

[b]Optimization and Settings[/b]
More settings will be included in the main menu to lower settings or lock your frame rate and the methods used to make the maps currently in the game seem to cause a lot of performance issues for people, new maps will be made using less hardware demanding tools.

[b]Difficulty[/b]
The biggest complaints are often about the difficulty of the game, many encounters will be better tested to be enough of a challenge to hopefully need your attention without being frustratingly hard. I'm also changing the player movement.

[b]Controls[/b]
The second biggest complaint is that the controls feel hard to control in various ways, some changes are being made to the gravity, the jump height, the speed of the character. Ive added in sound effects for walking and landing which help with the feeling of the new controls as well.

[b]The tutorial[/b]
All the iterations of the tutorial that there has been have all had many many flaws. The new tutorial that I'm working on now for the new controls and everything will let you learn the game at a slower pace, in smaller chunks, and the tutorial wont push you into challenging situations, I'll save that for the actual levels as it should be.

[b]For those who do like the secrets...[/b]
They will still be around, just much much much harder to find.

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
This game released in a pretty bad state and there's been a few needed updates but many changes have been needed that haven't come around yet. I want to keep trying to improve the game and really rework everything. I hope you have enjoyed the game to some extent and it'd be very motivating to hear your feedback and thoughts on the game. It may still be a while before the update will come out since the changes affect the game in so many ways that the current levels can't be beat with the new controls so everything needs to be changed. Anyway, thank you for playing!

notes.title: Update #3!
notes.content: Some people have been speed running the game so I will try to regularly showcase who has the fastest time on Speedrun.com

notes.title: Update #2!
notes.content:
I've added some additional tutorial text notes to help players understand the game as well as adjusting the difficulty in a couple of areas but as the game is a challenging game I don't intend the make it easier just hopefully give the player a better chance! The tutorial is redone in a way that will hopefully set players up with the right expectation and understanding to get through the levels. I am looking into possibly adding some additional features in future updates such as a timer so you know how long you take beating each level.

If you don't mind taking the time any and all reviews are welcome, I would love to get as much feedback as possible!

notes.title: Update!
notes.content: I happened to notice many people not being able to wall run properly due to the shortcomings of the tutorial. I went through and updated the system to only turn the camera upon successfully activating the wall run as well as teach wall running better through the tutorial. I also changed the start point of the intro song to include a better portion of the song that being said it now feels very abrupt and is subject to more change if I make another update. In addition to these changes 1 final secret was added and the others were slightly updated. Thank you for playing this game!!
